question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing right midfielder, and Claire is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) right midfielder
(C) left back
solution:
Position order: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (goalkeeper, right midfielder, left back).
1. Claire and Alice swap: (left back, right midfielder, goalkeeper).
2. Claire and Bob swap: (left back, goalkeeper, right midfielder).
3. Bob and Claire swap: (left back, right midfielder, goalkeeper).
Alice is playing left back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
